about.title: About {name}
about.publications.heading: Rule sets and schemas
about.publications.text: Validation uses exactly these published files, unchanged. Every statement about conformance refers to these releases and to nothing newer.
about.publications.title: Publication
about.disclaimer.heading: Disclaimer
about.disclaimer.risk: Use this software entirely at your own risk.
about.disclaimer.advice: It is a technical tool and gives no legal, tax or accounting advice.

check.failed: The check could not be carried out: {detail}
check.verdict.scope: This is the result of a technical validation against the releases named below, and of nothing newer. It says nothing about the content of the invoice or the legal requirements of a country.
check.identifier.differs: The invoice names a specification that belongs to the profile {profile}. It was checked as another profile.
check.ruleSets.heading: Checked against
check.findings.notEvaluated: The rule could not be evaluated (error {code}).
check.schema.heading: XML Schema
check.schema.valid: The file is valid against the XML Schema of its syntax.
check.schema.invalid: The file is not valid against the XML Schema of its syntax.
refusal.tooLarge: The file is larger than {mebibytes} MiB and is not read.
refusal.notUtf8: The file is not text in UTF-8. Other encodings are not supported.
refusal.malformed: The file is not well-formed XML: {detail}
refusal.unsupportedDocument: The file is XML, but not an invoice in UBL or CII. Its document element is "{element}".
refusal.nothingToCheck: There is no invoice to check again.
refusal.internal: The check failed for a reason that lies in the program, not in the file.
